context: Sakura attempts to set up a new home office space; consults Ren.
purpose: Author setting up workspace with friend's help.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Ren — is this desk okay here?
lines.style: Soft, practical question with genuine curiosity underneath. Light breath at the name. Checking in, not demanding. Warm but matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 窓向き、集中できますよ。
lines.style: Quiet observation delivered with a hint of wonder at his own preference. Gentle conviction — not self-assured, just honest. Slight trailing thought.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Straightforward, practical action. Small moment of settling in. No performance — just doing. Curious attention on the physical feeling.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Does the height work for you?
lines.style: Solicitous, careful concern. Leans slightly forward with the question. Not hovering — genuinely wanting to know if she's comfortable. Soft emphasis on 'work.'

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Bright, genuine relief and pleasure. Quick attack on the first word. Unguarded enthusiasm — no irony, just real happiness at finding something right.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Quiet approval, almost to himself. Satisfied nod in the voice. Warm recognition of something working out. Simple, genuine — no overstatement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう、書きたくなる!
lines.en: Thank you — I actually want to write now.
lines.style: Soft gratitude with surprised pleasure underneath. Small exhale before 'actually.' The relief of finding the right space. Tender but not performative.
